description.narrative: Malawi, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Malawi (MOH)This program has the following goals: To reduce the 2012 levels of malaria incidence and malaria deaths by 50% by 2016. The objectives of this program are: By 2016, all suspected malaria cases presenting to a health worker are tested and treated according to national guidelines. By 2016, at least 80% of the population will be protected by one or more malaria preventive interventions. By 2016, at least 80% of the populations will practice positive behaviors to prevent and control malaria. By 2016, systems for surveillance, monitoring, evaluation and operational research will be strengthened to provide timely and quality information necessary to effectively guide programmatic decision-making. To enhance programme performance for effective coordination and management at all levels of health service delivery by 2016
